page_title: AUG 0-2 LEV | Augsburg v Bayer Leverkusen 14/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+4' Augsburg are ruled offside.
90+2' Xabi Alonso has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Arthur (Bayer Leverkusen) replacing Jeremie Frimpong.
90+2' Alejandro Grimaldo goes off the pitch and Jeanuel Belocian (Bayer Leverkusen) comes on.
90+2' Kristijan Jakic (Augsburg) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header just wide of the right post.
90+1' Marius Wolf (Augsburg) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
90+1' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) creates space for himself on the edge of the box and smacks a hard shot towards the middle of the goal, but it's an easy save for Lukas Hradecky.
90' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
90' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Marius Wolf (Augsburg). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
87' Nathan Tella comes off the pitch to be replaced by Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen).
87' Here is a change. Robert Andrich is going off and Xabi Alonso gives the last tactical orders to Exequiel Palacios (Bayer Leverkusen).
87' Substitution. Frank Onyeka makes way for Steve Mounie (Augsburg).
87' Chrislain Matsima (Augsburg) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
86' Flag goes up against Henri Koudossou (Augsburg) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
86' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Nediljko Labrovic comes off the line to clear the ball away.
81' Kristijan Jakic (Augsburg) commits a rough foul. Felix Zwayer stops the game and makes a call.
79' A cross from the corner kick arrives at the feet of Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen), giving him an opportunity to shoot. He misses completely, way over the bar.
79' Corner kick. Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) is ready to send the ball into the box.
76' The substitution is prepared. Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Samuel Essende.
74' The attendance for today's match is 30000.
73' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
72' Felix Zwayer blows his whistle and signals a foul after Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) brought his opponent down.
70' Jeffrey Gouweleeuw (Augsburg) wins the ball from the corner kick and strikes. The effort lacks accuracy and flies wide of the target.
69' Marius Wolf (Augsburg) takes the corner.
69' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) comes onto the pitch for Martin Terrier.
66' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
66' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
66' An attempted cross from Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) is cleared.
64' Felix Zwayer interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen).
63' The referee blows his whistle after Samuel Essende (Augsburg) does a good impression of a basketball player and handles the ball.
59' Jess Thorup decides to make a substitution. Phillip Tietz will be replaced by Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg).
59' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Henri Koudossou (Augsburg) comes onto the pitch so that Dimitrios Giannoulis can be given a rest.
59' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Samuel Essende (Augsburg) heads on.
56' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it fails to bother the goalkeeper as it hits the defensive wall.
54' What was Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.

54' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the right side of the goal, but Nediljko Labrovic thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
48' Marius Wolf (Augsburg) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
48' Dimitrios Giannoulis (Augsburg) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.

47' Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Lukas Hradecky pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
46' Jess Thorup has made a change at the break. Mert Komur has come on in place of Arne Maier (Augsburg).
46' The whistle blows and Felix Zwayer starts the second half.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+2' The corner kick from Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' A decent effort by Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) from a close-range free kick! His attempt flies narrowly over the crossbar.
44' Jeffrey Gouweleeuw (Augsburg) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
44' Jeffrey Gouweleeuw (Augsburg) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
43' The linesman raises his flag. Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) is adjudged offside.
43' Piero Hincapie (Bayer Leverkusen) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Felix Zwayer blows his whistle for a foul.
40' 0 - 2 Goal - 0:2! Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) gets a shot away from the edge of the box and scores into the bottom right corner. Nathan Tella provided an assist for the goal.
40' Jeffrey Gouweleeuw (Augsburg) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
39' Marius Wolf (Augsburg) takes the corner but it's cleared.
39' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Dimitrios Giannoulis (Augsburg), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
37' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.

34' Frank Onyeka (Augsburg) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Felix Zwayer with no other option than to blow for a foul.
31' Florian Wirtz launches a cross from the corner, but Nediljko Labrovic (Augsburg) is alert to thwart the effort.
29' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
26' Piero Hincapie (Bayer Leverkusen) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
26' It looks like Keven Schlotterbeck (Augsburg) saw red with that tackle. Felix Zwayer won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
23' Keven Schlotterbeck (Augsburg) has a goal ruled out for offside!
23' Edmond Tapsoba (Bayer Leverkusen) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
23' The game is interrupted as Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) is flagged offside.
21' Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Felix Zwayer has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
20' Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
18' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a weak shot high over the bar from the edge of the box.
14' 0 - 1 Goal - 0:1! Martin Terrier (Bayer Leverkusen) receives a precise pass inside the box from Jeremie Frimpong and he beats the goalkeeper with a neat finish into the bottom right corner.
12' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Frank Onyeka (Augsburg) was quite harsh and Felix Zwayer didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
11' Felix Zwayer blows his whistle after Arne Maier (Augsburg) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
9' The linesman signals that Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
8' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
7' The corner from Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) is intercepted by the defence.
7' Jeffrey Gouweleeuw (Augsburg) was too forceful with his tackle and Felix Zwayer interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
6' Arne Maier (Augsburg) picks up a pass and unleashes a low shot towards goal, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Lukas Hradecky.
3' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Augsburg will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Felix Zwayer.
